stages.title: Immersion
stages.description: Listen to trusted Hawaiian-language audio without turning it into a quiz.

stages.title: Sentence Patterns
stages.description: See how Hawaiian sentences are organized and build understanding in context.

stages.title: Vocabulary in Context
stages.description: Planned: grow vocabulary through sentences and meaningful use.

units.title: Foundations: Sound & Writing
units.description: Build accurate Hawaiian spelling habits before vocabulary and grammar become larger. ʻOkina and kahakō are meaningful parts of spelling, not optional decoration.
outcomes: Recognize the ʻokina as a consonant/glottal stop
Type common Hawaiian words with the ʻokina and kahakō in the right places

lessons.title: ʻOkina & Kahakō
lessons.summary: Repair spellings and learn to notice exactly where ʻokina and kahakō belong.

units.title: Immersion: Listening
units.description: Spend time hearing Hawaiian from trusted sources without turning listening into a test.
outcomes: Become more comfortable hearing Hawaiian spoken naturally
Notice rhythm, pacing, vowel length, and ʻokina over time
Replay trusted audio freely without affecting mastery scores

lessons.title: HAW 101 Listening
lessons.summary: Listen to an official UH Hilo HAW 101 recording for immersion and ear training.

units.title: Sentence Foundations
units.description: Move from isolated words into source-checked Hawaiian sentence patterns, starting with understanding how the parts fit together.
outcomes: Notice that Hawaiian sentence order does not have to mirror English
Identify the action, who, and other key parts in a beginner sentence
Build toward sentence production only after the pattern is familiar

lessons.title: See the Pattern: Pepeke Painu
lessons.summary: Study one source-checked sentence and see how its parts work together before trying to produce the pattern yourself.

units.title: Vocabulary in Context
units.description: Planned: learn new vocabulary through source-checked sentences and situations instead of isolated word lists.
outcomes: Use familiar words in meaningful situations
